text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Morningside Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit westbound U-turn movements on Morningside Avenue at Finch Avenue East/Staines Road. The proposed U-turn prohibitions will address traffic safety concerns in the area.
City Council on November 13 and 14, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit westbound U-turn movements at all times on Morningside Avenue at Finch Avenue East/Staines Road.
